id: On the right is an example of a cracked ice tile. You can walk over it once, but step on it again and you'll fall through to another map.
en: On the right is an example of a cracked ice tile.  You can walk over it once, but step on it again and you'll fall through to another map.
it: A destra c'è un esempio di lastra di ghiaccio incrinata. Puoi camminarci sopra una volta, ma se la calpesti di nuovo cadrai in un'altra mappa.

id: In this case, you will "fall down" to a different part of this same map. There's no difference to warrant the two levels of this cave to be on different maps.
en: In this case, you will "fall down" to a different part of this same map.  There's no difference to warrant the two levels of this cave to be on different maps.
it: In questo caso "cadrai" in un'altra parte di questa stessa mappa. Non c'è alcuna differenza che giustifichi mettere i due livelli della grotta su mappe diverse.
